narr: Unusually strong wind shear combined with strong instability and numerous disturbances led to a very active period of severe weather through the month of June. Numerous reports of large hail and damaging winds were recorded along with a few tornadoes.
ev: Heavy rain caused creek to overflow and flood a basement.
Heavy rain caused water to overflow roadway on Highway 21S.
lsr: Report from mPING: River/Creek overflowing; Cropland/Yard/Basement Flooding.
911 dispatch reports water covering roadway on Hwy 21 S near Goodway Rd.
